title: Rules & Regulations of the Totalsports Two Oceans Marathon 2026 — rule 6.13 seconding
claims: Rule 6.13 states that the no mobile seconding rule will be strictly enforced, and that no seconds may drive, cycle or run alongside any athlete on the route.
The same rule applies a stand-and-hand rule: an athlete's seconds may stand at any refreshment station on the route and hand refreshments to their athlete while they remain stationary.
The rule adds that no seconds may travel on the race route, and that seconding may not be conducted directly from a vehicle, whether moving or stationary.
The official FAQ says the well-stocked refreshment stations should be adequate, but supporter points will be allowed, and asks supporters not to leave a mess.
The official FAQ states that non-entrants are not permitted to run on the route.

Rule 6.4 says ultra marathon athletes are seeded into starting batches based on their submitted qualifying times, and that gun-to-mat or mat-to-mat qualifying times may be submitted if they appear in the official results of the qualifying event.
